settings.heading: 1. What is MedTech Marketplace?
settings.row_content: MedTech Marketplace is an online platform designed to help access MedTech companies directly. It provides easier procurement, transparent pricing, and the ability to connect with reps and suppliers quickly.

settings.heading: 2. Who can use MedTech Marketplace?
settings.row_content: Is a central place for Healthcare providers and institutions (or even everyday Australians) to transact with MedTech industry. Browse products, generate quotes, and track orders, interact with MedTech suppliers and more.

settings.heading: 3. How does pricing work?
settings.row_content: Pricing shown on MedTech Marketplace reflects your hospital group’s negotiated rates. After sign-in, you will see the specific pricing available to your institution.

settings.heading: 4. Can hospitals sell surplus or expiring stock?
settings.row_content: Yes. Hospitals can list products they no longer need, are nearing expiry, or have already expired. MedTech Marketplace helps connect sellers with potential buyers, reducing wastage and supporting sustainability.

settings.heading: 5. How do I connect with my local rep?
settings.row_content: The “Find My Rep” feature lets you instantly identify and contact your local product representative for support, training, or urgent requirements.

settings.heading: 6. Is MedTech Marketplace secure?
settings.row_content: Yes. All transactions and data are handled securely with encrypted systems. Your procurement and patient data remain protected at all times.

settings.heading: 7. How do suppliers list their products?
settings.row_content: Suppliers can apply to list their products by contacting the MedTech Marketplace team at support@medtech-marketplace.com. The platform focuses on challenger companies with innovative solutions that offer value to hospitals.

settings.heading: 8. Does MedTech Marketplace integrate with hospital systems?
settings.row_content: Yes. Orders, quotes, and tracking information can be exported to support your existing procurement processes. Custom integrations are available for larger hospital groups on request.
